cases.prompt: Write only Python code for a function clamp(x, low, high) that returns low when x is below low, high when x is above high, otherwise x. No imports are needed.
cases.tests:
assert clamp(-2, 0, 10) == 0
assert clamp(12, 0, 10) == 10
assert clamp(4, 0, 10) == 4
